what_happened: On an open multi-lane highway with the lane ahead clear and the gap growing (19 m to 60 m and then no lead), the ego braked hard for no visible reason, from 16.9 to 5.6 m/s, and fell about 20 m behind the recorded position. Replayed actor 18, which does not react to the ego, then drove into the ego's right-rear while the ego was still braking. The overlap counted as a front collision, but the ego was not driving into anything.

The ego braked hard on an open highway, from 16.9 to 5.4 m/s, with no lead vehicle closer than about 19 m, and drifted slightly toward the left lane. It fell about 20 m behind its recorded position, and by 7.6 s actor 28 (shown ahead earlier) was sitting right on top of the ego's right side, which the metrics scored as a front collision with rear contact as well. This looks like unprovoked hard braking leaving the ego in the way of traffic that doesn't react to it, not driving into a lead car.

The ego was going straight on a freeway right on the recorded path (0.1 m off) but slowing from 9.7 to 8.0 m/s with no one close ahead, which left it about 24 m behind where the recorded car was. Actor 24, replayed from the log, came up from behind on the right and moved into the ego's front-right corner, which was logged as a front collision. Actor 24 also hit the ego's rear.
